source_order: frozen canonical product-grid order; the bridge case binds the accepted cached 93 source array
query_coordinates: recreate the existing 16 tensor Gauss-Legendre interface points from geometry and interface_quadrature fields; no new geometry or surface claim
rotation_contract: X'=R X+t and origin'=R origin+t; R is proper, oblique, and not an axis permutation; scalar reference_scale and support_radius remain unchanged in metres
unit_contract: mm run multiplies every coordinate, reference_origin, reference_scale, and support_radius by 1000; weights are compared directly and gradients are converted to per metre by multiplying the per-mm result by 1000; no material parameter is changed
negative_control: apply a nonuniform diagonal stretch to source and query offsets about reference_origin while intentionally retaining scalar reference_scale/support_radius; actual shape weights must detect the changed geometry
